<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
$probe_email = 'stage-d-probe@example.test';
$editor_id = wp_insert_user( array(
    'user_login' => 'stage_d_probe_editor',
    'user_pass'  => 'Probe-Editor-2026!x',
    'user_email' => $probe_email,
    'role'       => 'editor',
) );
$submission_id = wp_insert_post( array(
    'post_type'    => 'raouf_submission',
    'post_status'  => 'private',
    'post_title'   => 'Stage D capability probe',
    'post_content' => 'PROBE-PII-DO-NOT-SHIP',
) );
update_post_meta( $submission_id, '_raouf_name',  'پروب ممیزی D' );
update_post_meta( $submission_id, '_raouf_phone', '09123456789' );
$pto  = get_post_type_object( 'raouf_submission' );
$caps = (array) $pto->cap;
wp_set_current_user( $editor_id );
$editor_can_read_post  = current_user_can( 'read_post', $submission_id );
$editor_can_edit_post  = current_user_can( 'edit_post', $submission_id );
$editor_can_read_priv  = current_user_can( $caps['read_private_posts'] );
$q = new WP_Query( array(
    'post_type'      => 'raouf_submission',
    'post_status'    => 'private',
    'posts_per_page' => -1,
    'fields'         => 'ids',
    'perm'           => 'readable',
) );
$probe = array(
    'wp_version'                       => get_bloginfo( 'version' ),
    'php_version'                      => PHP_VERSION,
    'editor_id'                        => (int) $editor_id,
    'submission_id'                    => (int) $submission_id,
    'cap_read_post'                    => $caps['read_post'],
    'cap_edit_post'                    => $caps['edit_post'],
    'cap_read_private_posts'           => $caps['read_private_posts'],
    'map_meta_cap'                     => $pto->map_meta_cap,
    'editor_can_read_post'             => $editor_can_read_post,
    'editor_can_edit_post'             => $editor_can_edit_post,
    'editor_can_read_private_cap'      => $editor_can_read_priv,
    'editor_private_submission_ids'    => array_map( 'intval', $q->posts ),
    'editor_private_submission_count'  => (int) $q->post_count,
);
file_put_contents( '/wordpress/wp-content/stage-d-capability-probe.json', wp_json_encode( $probe, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_PRETTY_PRINT ) );
